‘kṣamāpaṇapañcāśat’
a name, partly wrong, of the Aparādhadaśakastotra, for which see NCC. I. Revised edn. p.. 248a, 249b [Page148-b] an. Aparādhastotra, 250a.

‘kṣudraka_Āgama’
Bud. Skt. canon corresponding to Khuddaka Nikāya but only parts of it are preserved. [Page154-a.

‘kṣemīndravidyāgama’
Kāmaśāstra mentioned in Pañcasāyaka (Peters. II. Extr. p. 110).
C.. below Vātsyāyanasūtrasāra, under Kṣemendra.
